name: Sable

seo.title: Sable Build Guide: Fastest Damage in Anvil Quest
seo.description: Sable trades health for the fastest attack chain in Anvil Quest. How to build her without dying, which materials fix her fragility, and why she is the speedrun pick.

summary: Sable has the lowest health pool and the highest damage ceiling in the game. She is the right choice if you already know the fights, and a very efficient way to die if you do not.
body:
Sable's identity is momentum. Her basic attack chains up to four hits, with each consecutive hit dealing 15% more damage than the last, and any hit landed resets a short dash cooldown. Play her well and she never stops moving. Play her badly and she has 90 max health and no way to absorb a mistake.

Because her damage scales with the chain, the material choice matters more for her than for anyone else. Slow, high-damage weapons actively hurt her — the wind-up breaks the chain and the multiplier resets. What she wants is anything that adds damage per hit rather than per swing, which makes chain-hit and bleed properties disproportionately strong on her.

portrait.alt: Sable, a lean character in light armor holding twin short blades

abilities.name: Slip
abilities.description: A short dash with 6 frames of invulnerability. Every successful hit reduces its cooldown by 0.4 seconds, which means a sustained chain gives you near-constant access to it. This is the entire defensive kit.

abilities.name: Thousand Cuts
abilities.description: Nine rapid strikes over two seconds. Damage per strike is low but each one counts as a chain hit, so used at the end of a four-hit combo it deals roughly four times its listed damage.

abilities.name: Read the Room
abilities.description: Passive. Sable gains 8% move speed for each enemy within four meters, up to three stacks. Being surrounded is bad for everyone except her.

tips: Never let the chain drop. A four-hit chain into a dash into another four-hit chain is roughly double the damage of attacking from neutral repeatedly.
Thousand Cuts is a finisher, not an opener. Using it from a cold chain wastes most of its damage.
On Emberfang, hug the right wall. Your dash cooldown is low enough that the fire trail never catches you if you keep circling.

faq.q: Is Sable good in Anvil Quest?
faq.a: Sable sits in tier 1 of the roster. She has the highest damage ceiling in the game, but the lowest health pool. She rewards players who already know the fights.
Max health 90, Base damage 14, Attack speed Very fast, Chain multiplier +15% per hit, Move speed Fast.
All three characters are available from the start. There is no unlock requirement, and swapping between runs is free.
